messages:
maria (docs): Heads-up — planning a deprecation window for /v1/invoke -> /v2. Timeline proposal: 2-week soft deprecate, 1-week hard enforcement. Need docs + SDK + examples coordinated. PR started: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2890

sam (sdk): Noted. SDK change includes a param rename ("model" -> "model_id") and embed-dim behavior changes. We have a compat shim but want clear examples. I'll open an SDK PR to add aliasing tests and a migration example. Watch out for raw embedding vectors code.

june (devex): Owners: @sam (SDK), @maria (docs), @leo (oncall). Checklist I want to track: update deprecation banner, fix code snippets across locales, update redirect map, add smoke tests, and add a clear "what breaks" section. Can someone grep for leftover /v1 snippets?

leo (eng-oncall): I'll run the canary with limited traffic and watch error delta. If rollback is needed we need a documented rollback path and a v1-compatible proxy. ops-bot will post deploy events.

sam (sdk): Quick grep that helps: `rg \"/v1/invoke|model: .*v1\" docs/ -n`
Also proposing a tiny compat example for SDK README:
```
# shim example
client.call({ model_id: client.alias('gpt-4-redwood') })
```

maria (docs): Docs patch checklist (short): 1) add deprecation banner + date; 2) update all code snippets (js, py, curl); 3) add migration section with example map; 4) update redirect map file; 5) run smoke tests. I'll take items 1 & 3.

june (devex): Smoke test example (curl):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -d '{\"model_id\":\"gpt-small\",\"input\":\"ping\"}'
```
Expect 200 and token_count in response. We'll wire this into /scripts/smoke/migrate_check.sh and add to CI canary job.

docs-lint-bot: Reminder: docs PRs must pass link-checker and code-block-lint. Failing PRs will be auto-closed after 72h.

maria (docs): PRs I'll open/patch: docs/pull/2890 (deprecation banner + notice), docs/pull/2891 (snippet updates & examples), sdk-js/pull/412 (compat tests). Will ping reviewers when ready.

leo (eng-oncall): When canary goes live I'll post status in #release-war-room and link this thread. If we see >0.5% error delta vs baseline, initiate rollback plan A.

june (devex): Small ask — please include a clear "what breaks" subsection in the migration doc that calls out embed-dim mismatches, streaming framing changes, and quantization caveats. Short examples please.

sam (sdk): Will add short examples and a fallback snippet. Also putting a short rollback command in the SDK ops notes:
```
# switch back to v1 proxy
./tools/route-switch --to v1-proxy --reason \"rollback: docs issue\"
```

maria (docs): Thanks all. Action items recap: sam -> add tests & compat snippet; june -> add smoke script path (/scripts/smoke/migrate_check.sh); leo -> prepare rollback playbook and run canary; docs-lint-bot -> enforce lint. Target: soft-deprec announcement tomorrow EOD. :raised_hands:
